source_reviews.independent_solution: 90a: Add 5 to both sides of 2x-5=3 to obtain 2x=8. Conversely subtract 5 from both sides of 2x=8. This is the same-addend property, used in both directions. 90b: Multiply 10x=24 by 1/10 to obtain x=24/10=12/5=2.4. Conversely multiply x=2.4 by 10. Both constants are nonzero, so the same-multiplier property is reversible. 90c: Multiply (x-2)/5=1 by 5 to obtain x-2=5. Conversely multiply x-2=5 by 1/5. Thus the equality-multiplication property proves both implications. 90d: Multiply every term of x/3+2=x/5 by 15: 15(x/3)+15*2=15(x/5), hence 5x+30=3x. Conversely divide the complete equality by 15. Solving gives 2x=-30 and x=-15.
